title: 书店拱门底下  (Under the Bookshop Arch)

segments.t: Halfway back down Wutong Lane, Teacher Song steps out from browsing sheet music under the cool stone arch of the neighbourhood second-hand bookshop just as Qing hurries up holding Clue Card Three. Listen to the whole scene first.
小晴，你来啦！我从小院客栈走上来，就希望能碰上你们寻宝！
宋老师，您选的地方太准了——这座石头拱门就是第三张线索卡片！
让我看看水彩画：这儿有拱门，还有木头推车呢！
您念底下那一行字：绿色共享书架旁，四个角等着重逢。
等等……快看左边墙上画着的那个小绿木头书架！
对呀！免费街坊草本和花园书——宋老师，您怎么那样笑呀？
天哪，小晴，星期四下午我刚从这儿借走了一本旧的绿树叶书！
不会吧！一本绿色布面的花园树叶书——现在在楼上四号房吗？！
就摆在窗台上我的茶杯旁边，我还没看完呢！
您觉得缺的那一半莓果蛋糕菜谱会不会夹在里面？！
等我们走完第四张线索卡片，马上一页一页翻！
快看书架上面的铜牌——有个箭头指着公园长椅！
Now let's go through it line by line with the English translation.
小晴，你来啦！我从小院客栈走上来，就希望能碰上你们寻宝！
'There you are, Qing! I walked up from Courtyard Inn hoping to meet your clue hunt!' "Zou shanglai" joins "walk" with "up toward here", showing Song climbed the lane toward where she now stands.
宋老师，您选的地方太准了——这座石头拱门就是第三张线索卡片！
'You picked the exact right spot, Teacher Song—this stone arch IS Clue Card Three!' Solid landmarks like arches, bridges, and towers take "zuo" as their counter, and "jiushi" stresses "is precisely".
让我看看水彩画：这儿有拱门，还有木头推车呢！
'Let me see the watercolour drawing: there is the arched doorway and the wooden cart!' "Tuiche" pairs "push" and "cart" for the bookshop's wheeled wooden display barrow parked beneath the arch.
您念底下那一行字：绿色共享书架旁，四个角等着重逢。

'Read the line underneath: Beside the green lending shelf, four corners wait to meet.' Pronounced "hang", this character counts a written line of words, whereas pronounced "xing" it means "all right".
等等……快看左边墙上画着的那个小绿木头书架！

'Wait a moment... look at that little green wooden shelf painted on the left wall!' attaching "shang" right onto "qiang", "wall", builds "qiangshang"—"on the wall"—without needing a separate word ahead of it.
对呀！免费街坊草本和花园书——宋老师，您怎么那样笑呀？

'Yes! Free Neighbourhood Herb and Garden Books—why are you smiling like that, Teacher Song?' "Caoben" pairs "grass" and "stem" for botanical herbs, while "jiefang" warmly names neighbours along the same street.
天哪，小晴，星期四下午我刚从这儿借走了一本旧的绿树叶书！
'Good heavens, Qing, on Thursday afternoon I borrowed an old green leaf book from here!' Bound books always take the counter "ben", and "cong zher jie zou" means "borrowed away from right here".
不会吧！一本绿色布面的花园树叶书——现在在楼上四号房吗？！
'NO WAY! An old green cloth book of garden leaves—is it upstairs in Room Four?!' Exclaiming "buhui ba!" literally asks "it couldn't be, could it?!"—Mandarin's lively everyday way to shout "no way!".
就摆在窗台上我的茶杯旁边，我还没看完呢！

'Sitting right beside my teacup on the windowsill, and I have not finished reading it yet!' "Chuangtai" joins "window" and "platform" for a windowsill, while "kan wan" tacks "finish" right onto "read".
您觉得缺的那一半莓果蛋糕菜谱会不会夹在里面？！
'Do you think the missing half of the berry cake recipe is tucked inside?!' "Jia" vividly pictures pressing a loose sheet flat between book pages, and "caipu" means a kitchen recipe.
等我们走完第四张线索卡片，马上一页一页翻！
'We will check every single page the moment we finish Clue Card Four!' Repeating a counter as "yi ye yi ye" means "page by page", and "fan" captures flipping briskly through a book.
快看书架上面的铜牌——有个箭头指着公园长椅！
'Look at the brass plaque above the shelf—an arrow pointing to the park bench!' "Tongpai" pairs "brass" and "plaque", while "changyi" literally says "long-chair" for a wooden park bench.
Now let's listen to the whole conversation one last time.
小晴，你来啦！我从小院客栈走上来，就希望能碰上你们寻宝！
宋老师，您选的地方太准了——这座石头拱门就是第三张线索卡片！

等等……快看左边墙上画着的那个小绿木头书架！
对呀！免费街坊草本和花园书——宋老师，您怎么那样笑呀？
天哪，小晴，星期四下午我刚从这儿借走了一本旧的绿树叶书！
不会吧！一本绿色布面的花园树叶书——现在在楼上四号房吗？！
就摆在窗台上我的茶杯旁边，我还没看完呢！
您觉得缺的那一半莓果蛋糕菜谱会不会夹在里面？！
等我们走完第四张线索卡片，马上一页一页翻！
快看书架上面的铜牌——有个箭头指着公园长椅！
Under the cool bookshop arch, Teacher Song realises the mysterious green book of garden leaves might already be waiting upstairs in Room 4! See you next time.
回头见！
